0x0008A4.en: 「So... this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008D6.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000947.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0009CF.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A49.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B30.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000BD3.en: 「I have to get out of here...!」

0x000BF9.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000C34.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000C88.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to withdraw...」

0x000CFC.en: 「Guh! I've got no choice but to pull back!!」

0x000D72.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000DD9.en: 「This is my limit... The rest is on you.」

0x000E47.en: 「Nngh! Did I let them get the jump on me...」

0x000E85.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000ED2.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F10.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F57.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x001002.en: 「Ngh... So I'm gonna be a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001081.en: 「I-I can't take any more of this...!」

0x00113E.en: 「U... ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x0011AB.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011F2.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x001227.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001313.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm not there yet...!」

0x001361.en: 「No good, I can't do any more! Retreating!」

0x00141C.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00144B.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001489.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x0014B8.en: 「I can't do any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x001543.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0015C0.en: 「Tch...! I couldn't hold out after all...!」

0x0016A9.en: 「I'm ejecting...@ Ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x0018D6.en: 「So I still have a ways to go...!」

0x001937.en: 「A-all hands! Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x001A14.en: 「Carla,@ have you ever been to Comodin Island?」

0x001AA5.en: 「A remote island out in the ocean, a resort for celebs with something to hide.@ A guy named Ruslan runs it.」

0x001B2C.en: 「Celebs with something to hide... what do you mean?」

0x001B69.en: 「You mean it's a place tied up in crime?」

0x001BA9.en: 「Hmm, well... it's borderline, maybe.@ But regular folks and celebrities@ come there to play too.」

0x001C2D.en: 「The fact that you're saying 'regular folks' already tells me plenty...」

0x001C76.en: 「Besides, resort or not,@ with the sky like that...」

0x001CD2.en: 「The net's spotty, so I don't know details...@ but since the government made a statement,@ the uproar seems to be spreading everywhere.」

0x001DC0.en: 「That some Guest covered the whole Earth@ in a special barrier...」

0x001E1F.en: 「A lie anyone could see through instantly.」

0x001E47.en: 「Do they really think everyone will believe@ such a preposterous story?」

0x001E9D.en: 「Maybe for us, who've made direct contact with the Ruina@ and know a bit of the situation, but...」

0x001F0E.en: 「If they admitted it's an unknown enemy or@ phenomenon, people would panic more - especially@ with the sun vanishing before their eyes.」

0x001FD7.en: 「So the government deliberately gave@ a more palatable explanation?」

0x00203F.en: 「Yes. Since the Federation and Gaia Sabers@ drove off the Guests once before, people can believe@ this crisis might work out too.」

0x0020FF.en: 「To give them hope?@ They're just covering it up.」

0x00214C.en: 「That's politicians for you.@ They're not the ones who'll fight the enemy.」

0x0021B4.en: 「Reassure everyone with a stopgap explanation,@ buy some time... then dump it all on the soldiers.」

0x00232A.en: 「After an incident like that...@ there's no need to keep faith with him anymore.」

0x0023A1.en: 「But... why did Alteur@ take an interest in Fabula Foores?」

0x00240F.en: 「Only Professor Radcliff, who dealt with him directly,@ would know that.」

0x00247D.en: 「...So the data on the Aile Chevalier@ and Blanche Neige@ had made its way to Gaia Sabers...」

0x002519.en: 「They keep turning up all over the place.@ Joshua being seconded to the Special Tactics Instructor Squad@ must have had some intent behind it too.」

0x0025CA.en: 「But what does it mean?@ The reason they sent us to the <Instructor Squad>@ instead of Gaia Sabers...」

0x002685.en: 「Ratsel... Major. You wanted to speak with me?」

0x0026BF.en: 「No need for rank, Second Lieutenant Hugo.@ Honestly, I'd hoped to talk with Major Kai present too.」

0x00279B.en: 「The Flickerei Geist brought aboard the Hagane...@ I heard the Jetzt's core was transplanted into it.」

0x00283D.en: 「This is what I heard from the Flickerei's pilot,@ Second Lieutenant Ariel Org, but...」

0x0028B4.en: 「The Zentr Project seems to be@ under Gaia Sabers' control.」

0x002929.en: 「From that reaction, it seems you didn't know either.」

0x002969.en: 「Y-yes... The current location of Tochka 1...@ Mitarl Zapad's whereabouts were classified,@ kept even from Aqua and me.」

0x002A3C.en: (So the powerful figure Mitarl mentioned@ was Alteur...!)

0x002AA7.en: 「Re-Tech's and the Zentr Project's machines being@ entrusted to the Instructor Squad at the same time@ is no mere coincidence.」

0x002B80.en: 「I... don't know.@ But if Mitarl is a member of Gaia Sabers...」

0x002C0A.en: 「then my suspicion toward@ the Zentr Project has only deepened.」

0x002C9D.en: 「...The Kreuz Wolfs I belonged to@ were wiped out fighting the Jetzt.」

0x002D27.en: 「I owe Mitarl Zapad no loyalty, no debt.」

0x002D70.en: 「Then one last question.@ Have you submitted any data to Gaia Sabers@ recently?」

0x002DF4.en: 「No.@ My father may have meant to compile the Aile Chevalier data@ at the South Pole and send it, but...」

0x002E8D.en: 「...The last time we sent data was@ before we left the Orleans factory.」

0x002F01.en: 「Could the data be transmitted automatically?@ In other words, is there any chance the machine@ has a transmitter planted in it?」

0x002F9A.en: 「No one from Gaia Sabers was involved@ in developing the Aile Chevalier or Blanche Neige.@ Nor have they ever touched the machines.」

0x003072.en: 「Second Lieutenant Hugo, what about your T-E Absorber?」

0x0030B2.en: 「...I can't say the chance is zero.」

0x003127.en: (If Mitarl is a member of Gaia Sabers,@ then contact with him is forbidden...)

0x00318C.en: (But if that's the case, my medicine...)

0x0031DD.en: 「Yo, Carla. Things going well@ with your boyfriend?」

0x003264.en: 「The sun's gone dark here too, so we're conserving power.@ A few hotel guests are stuck, unable to get home,@ but we're basically closed for business.」

0x003312.en: 「There's work, all right.@ First off, I need repairs and a supply loadout.」

0x00336E.en: 「This state of emergency...@ and you're all full-blown wanted fugitives now.@ Thirty percent surcharge, paid in full up front.」

0x0033F5.en: 「Hey, Ruslan!@ Aren't you taking advantage a little too much!?」

0x003448.en: 「Carla, my dear,@ we're taking plenty of risks over here too, you know?」

0x0034A1.en: 「Very well.@ The cash is ready right here.」

0x0034E8.en: 「...Alright, it's a deal.@ Andrew, have them start the work.」

0x003576.en: 「By the way, Ratsel.@ This lady here is the squadron commander...?」

0x00360C.en: 「I can't thank you enough for taking us in@ under these circumstances, Mister...」

0x003686.en: 「Ruslan Makarov.@ No need for a stuffy 'Mister.'@ Just call me Ruslan.」

0x003710.en: 「Then, Ruslan...@ we'll be in your care for a while.」

0x003769.en: 「We've hardly any staff, so I can't offer much@ in the way of hospitality, but...@ please make yourselves comfortable.」

0x0037ED.en: 「I'd love to take you up on that, but we can't just relax.@ If you're short-handed, we'll handle@ hauling in the supplies ourselves.」

0x0038AA.en: 「I'll pitch in too, so knock a bit off the price, yeah?」

0x0038F9.en: 「Well, well, I'm no match for you, Carla.」

0x003992.en: 「Ah, I've been expecting him. Show him in.」

0x0039F4.en: 「Picked him up on Mulberry Island.@ Saw some promise in him, so I've got him on as an errand boy.」

0x003AAC.en: 「I know the situation. You've had a rough time of it...」

0x003AEF.en: 「To the point, Major Yager...@　what's the Joint Chiefs' take on the incident?」

0x003B60.en: 「...They see the Steel Dragon Squadron as the president's killers.@　Stripped of rank... with a warrant out for your arrest.」

0x003BDD.en: 「Stripped of rank...@　So that's why we can't reach the Joint Chiefs...」

0x003C45.en: 「And you came here anyway?@　You sure that's smart?」

0x003CA4.en: 「Lieutenant General Jacob Moore believes the Steel Dragons@　walked into a trap set by Alteur Steinbeck.@　That's why he sent me.」

0x003D7A.en: 「From here on, under the general's orders...@　you'll operate as an independent strike unit.@　Officially, though, nothing changes.」

0x003E25.en: 「The Joint Chiefs have to save face@　with the Federation and the Gaia Sabers,@　so they can't openly back you.」

0x003EF8.en: 「General Moore isn't thinking@　anything of the sort.」

0x003F54.en: 「From now on, I'll fight alongside the Steel Dragons.@ My cover task is investigating the Gaia Sabers...@ but I'll also join your operations.」

0x004027.en: 「Say, Major Yager. This General Moore... who is he?」

0x004073.en: 「The head of my intelligence division.@　A sharp mind with deep ties in politics and finance.」

0x0040E1.en: 「If a man like that is backing us,@　that's reassuring... but still.」

0x00413D.en: 「Even so, we need proof that Alteur Steinbeck@　plotted the president's assassination.」

0x0041B7.en: 「General Moore said he'd reach out to the@ lawmakers who resent Alteur's rise to power...@ but...」

0x004250.en: 「Until we find solid proof,@　the Federation Army and the Gaia Sabers@　will keep hunting the Steel Dragons.」

0x0042EA.en: 「Still, it's important that we show our intent@　to plead our case at the right time and place.」

0x004361.en: 「The situation is dire... but you must@　hold out until we have that proof.」

0x0043D8.en: 「We're... prepared for that.@　We can't fight our own in a time like this.@　Nor will we ignore threats from outside.」

0x004498.en: 「Understood.@　I'll convey your resolve to General Moore.」

0x004510.en: 「...Ratsel, there's more I want to discuss.@　After we load the Type RV onto the Hiryu,@　could you spare me some time?」

0x0045AC.en: 「All right. Then I'll head to the Hiryu as well.」

0x00462A.en: 「The DFC sub-circuit's still suspect...@　They told me not to open it up unless@　we're doing a full overhaul.」

0x004710.en: （...My supply of the drug is running low.@　I can't restock unless I contact Mitarl.）

0x004784.en: （Guess I'll have to cut the dose to stretch it...）

0x0047F9.en: 「What if the Medius Locus wasn't stolen...@　What if it was a Gaia Sabers unit@　from the very start?」

0x0048C3.en: 「But why pit us against the Medius in a real fight...?」

0x004909.en: 「Both machines could end up wrecked, you know?@　If they need data... and these are both prototypes,@　you'd normally run a mock battle.」

0x0049CF.en: 「...Maybe they needed us to fight for real.」

0x004A46.en: 「What's this device...?@　It's not in the spec notes...!」

0x004B1C.en: 「Multiple high-heat sources incoming from above, likely missiles!」

0x004B6F.en: 「Anti-air defenses!@　Recall the captain and the crew on loading@　duty at once!」

0x004BE8.en: 「Commander Webley, we'll launch first.@　And get Ruslan and the others to shelter inside.」

0x004C81.en: （If the enemy really is the Gaia Sabers...@　then my hunch was right.）

0x004D11.en: 「Touma!@　Dawdle out there and you'll die!@　Get to the Hiryu, now!」

0x004E01.en: 「Don't panic!@　Get our guests to the Hiryu!」

0x004E67.en: 「...Sorry I'm late! Give me a status report!」

0x004EA4.en: 「We're under attack from above.@　Heavy EA is masking the enemy's type and position.」

0x004F1B.en: 「Launch every machine that's ready!@　We'll prep to depart while taking in refugees!」

0x004F92.en: 「An object descending from above! Count is one!」

0x004FE8.en: 「The one the Instructor Corps ran into...!」

0x005038.en: 「Yeah... never thought he'd show up here.」

0x005069.en: 「That giant from back then... DyGenGuard...@　To think I'd lay eyes on it again...!」

0x0050D4.en: 「Is the one beside it a DyGenGuard too...?」

0x005142.en: 「Just like Ratsel's report said,@　it resembles the Double G.」

0x0051DF.en: 「I. Am. Jinrai.@ That which is the Dynamic General Guardian@ ...and surpasses it.」

0x005263.en: 「I, who am Double G Unit 3... my purpose:@ the destruction of Units 1 and 2.」

0x00532A.en: （Dr. Tomine loathed Commander Bian, so I doubt@　he'd give it the Dynamic General Guardian name...@　much less call it Unit 3.）

0x0053F6.en: 「Very well, black machine-ninja!@　I accept this duel with my DyGenGuard@　and the Type-3 Zankantou!!」

0x00547A.en: 「With a raging blade, I quell the thunderclap!!」

0x0054E2.en: 「Double G Unit 3...@　Whoever sent that thing...!」

0x005597.en: 「Might be wise to watch and wait a while.」

0x0055D7.en: 「Captain, all units are ready to launch!」

0x00562D.en: 「Ninja robot!@　I won't let you do as you please anymore!!」

0x00567D.en: 「About time you showed! Count on me, Carla!」

0x0056C6.en: （If the transmitter planted in the TE Absorber@　is what gave away our position...!）

0x005740.en: 「What's with this guy!@　This ain't some ninja village!」

0x00579C.en: 「That one's a Dynamic General Guardian too,@　same as our machines.@　Don't let your guard down.」

0x005817.en: 「So it's Double G versus Double G?@　But when you say 'versus,' they usually end up@　fighting together later. It's a super robot, after all.」

0x0058D8.en: 「In a monster movie, they'd stay enemies.」

0x00590F.en: 「Ooh, sharp retort. You're pretty good, aren't you?」

0x00594F.en: 「Is this the time for idle chatter?」

0x005A76.en: （Damn it... cut the dose and this is what I get...!）

0x005B43.en: 「Mass-production types, by the look of them.」

0x005B74.en: 「So Jinrai's the elite, and those are just the grunts!」

0x005BB1.en: 「Tch, is this really a ninja village or what!」

0x005C38.en: 「J-Jinrai alone was trouble enough,@　and now there's a whole squad of them...!」

0x005CA3.en: 「Something overhead must have carried them here...@　All units, stay alert to the skies.」

0x005DF2.en: 「I feel it too. What is this?」

0x005EC7.en: 「A little girl?! What's she doing there!」

0x005EF8.en: 「There's no one else around!@　She's the only one who couldn't escape!」

0x005F48.en: 「There's a Jinrai near her! We have to save her!」

0x005FFC.en: 「No, we're the closest, so we'll go!」

0x00603C.en: 「The Altairlion's speed can get there in one shot!」

0x006082.en: 「TD4 to Dragon 2!@ Found the girl who couldn't escape! Permission to rescue!」

0x0060E7.en: 「Yes, please!@ Machines near the Altairlion, give her cover!」

0x006140.en: 「Ready, Ibis?@　Get to that child within two minutes!」

0x006193.en: 「Any longer than that and it's too dangerous! Hurry!」

0x006207.en: 「One minute left!@　Hurry, get to that child!」

0x00629B.en: 「Come on, this way!@ Get onto the Altairlion's palm!」

0x006313.en: 「Ibis,@　that child's in deep shock!@　Get her into the cockpit!」

0x0063E8.en: （This girl... fear and despair@　have frozen her stiff...!）

0x006441.en: （It's the same... as me, back when@　Project TD started to look shaky@　and I nearly lost sight of my dream...）

0x0064CE.en: （The same as me... when Filio died@　and the shock hit me...）

0x006524.en: （So small, yet feeling such terror and grief...@　I have to protect her... I have to...）

0x0065C0.en: 「Don't be afraid. It's okay.@　I'll... I'll protect you, no matter what...」

0x0066BA.en: 「Then all that's left is to slay these machine-ninja!」

0x0067AF.en: 「Excellence Rescue, carry out rescue operations.@　All other units, tighten your all-around watch.」

0x006826.en: 「Taking down Jinrai before we even reached@　the target point... impressive, as always.」

0x0068F3.en: 「Altairlion, return to ship.@ Excellence Rescue, carry out rescue operations,@ all other units, tighten your all-around watch.」

0x00698C.en: 「My apologies, Ruslan.@　It never should have come to this...」

0x0069FA.en: 「The damage was only to the harbor, true,@　but if that's ruined, it's a fatal blow...」

0x006A7A.en: 「Well, the generous Ratsel@　will make up for it, I'm sure.」

0x006ADC.en: 「...I intend to do all I can.」

0x006B19.en: 「I'll put it on your tab.@　In exchange, ferry us to Lima@　or Mexico, would you?」

0x006B9A.en: 「If we stay on this island and that ninja robot@　shows up again, we're in for it.」

0x006C3C.en: 「Yes. Then let's set course for Lima.」

0x006C73.en: 「...But with the satellite link down,@　how did they find out we were on this island?」

0x006CFF.en: 「...It seems a transmitter had been@　planted in the TE Absorber.」

0x006D7A.en: 「So that's how it was, after all...」

0x006DA5.en: 「I destroyed the transmitter before@　we sortied. Too late to matter, though...」

0x006E07.en: 「Then there's a strong chance it was the@　Gaia Sabers who sent Jinrai after us.」

0x006E75.en: 「I-I'm sorry. If only I'd noticed@　sooner...」

0x006ED1.en: 「You didn't know either, Aqua.@ There's nothing you could've done.」

0x006F70.en: 「Most likely Dr. Kaoru Tomine...@　He may be with the Gaia Sabers now.」

0x006FED.en: 「...As I recall, Dr. Tomine held a@　grudge against Dr. Bian Zoldark, didn't he?」

0x007070.en: 「Yes. And if that grudge is aimed at@　Aussenseiter and DyGenGuard...@　he'll be a dangerous pursuer for us now.」

0x00711E.en: 「I circled the island. No one got@　left behind.」

0x0071B3.en: 「You saved me back then...@　Fighter Roar, right!」

0x007290.en: 「A civilian, then. Same as me, more or less.」

0x0072D0.en: 「Y-you and DyGenGuard saved me@　back in Hakodate!」

0x00733C.en: 「Ah, wait, maybe...@　you're the guy Shura General Magnus had captured...?」

0x0073A7.en: 「That's it! Let me thank you properly.」

0x0073F7.en: 「Hakodate...I was there too.@　Funny, running into you in a place like this.」

0x007487.en: 「...The doctor says she'll be fine if she@　rests a little longer.」

0x007508.en: 「But...why was that girl@　out there all alone?」

0x007589.en: 「There's a tourist hotel on this island,@　right? Wasn't she a guest there?」

0x0075EE.en: 「Then why haven't her parents shown up,@　even though we've taken in every civilian@　on the island?」

0x007668.en: 「Hmm...guess we won't know unless we ask her?」

0x0076AB.en: 「Not now.@　She won't say a word, no matter what.@　She hasn't gotten over the shock yet...」

0x007781.en: 「Ibis, could you@　try talking to her?」

0x0078B0.en: 「Oh, you don't need to thank me.@　It was just a mission.」

0x007928.en: 「Ibis, you can't put it like that.」

0x007971.en: 「R-really...?@　I'm not used to this kind of thing...」

0x0079CA.en: 「Come on, Kusuha, you were a nurse.@　I'll leave this to you.」

0x007A17.en: 「In cases like this, the first step matters.@　Just be gentle with her.」

0x007A94.en: 「Um...I'd like to know your name.@ Can you tell me what it is?」

0x007B78.en: 「I'm Ibis.@　Um...nice to meet you, Irui.」
